sam: quick alert - 00:14 UTC we started seeing TLS client cert validation failures for svc-cache in eu-central and sa-east. small but steady error rate.
nina: any recent RBAC or cert work?
sam: we rolled a permissions tighten on cert-rotator SA at 2024-08-02T00:05 (PR 5012). suspect correlation.
rob: grabbed one proxy log: `2024-08-02T00:14:21Z tls: handshake error: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority (missing intermediate)`
sam: pulled rotator endpoint: `GET /v1/keys/svc-cache` -> response shows `intermediates: []` and `issued_by: internal-ca`
kms-watchbot: CloudKMS DENY: 3 events for projects/prod/keyRings/certs/cryptoKeys/unwrap from serviceAccount:cert-rotator@prod between 00:05-00:07 UTC
rob: looks like unwrap blocked. mitigation: re-add decrypt role for rotator, restart pods so they rebuild chains.
nina: I'm applying targeted IAM binding now (temporary) and will add an alert for any future DENY.
ops-bot: IAM change applied by infra-ci at 00:20 UTC; rotator rollout started.
sam: handshakes recovered ~00:23 UTC. impact minimal but non-zero.
rob: action items: 1) add CI preflight: canary unwrap for any PR touching cert RBAC; 2) rotator: validate chain before publishing and fall back to cached chain; 3) add KMS DENY->pagerduty for critical SAs.
nina: I'll open follow-up PRs: terraform guard + DENY alert + rotator patch.
sam: include incident note for postmortem. schedule 15m follow-up tomorrow.
rob: also recommend ingress validation to reject leaf-only bundles to fail fast.
ina: thanks, closing loop for now.
